# WO-207: Refresh the FAQ page
Status: open (revised scope; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / CLAUDE-036

## Goal
Make answers on `/faq/` easier to scan and read without changing the approved answers or sources.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve existing FAQ content, sources, and meaning; flag any content concern rather than rewriting or adding claims.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Keep question/answer relationships semantic and accessible by keyboard and assistive technology.
- Add focused built-output checks for question headings, answer associations, and key links.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/faq/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_faq_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No FAQ source data, home-page FAQ, app, global chrome/styles, shared tokens, CSP, dependencies, or other routes.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_faq_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_faq_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-206 is integrated on a main containing reviewed foundation.

## Notes and decisions
The in-house team freezes edits to this route while this WO is active. Keep answer wording and source notes stable.
